Scene 01

Scene 01

Morris Fletcher

Once upon a time, there were three... How should I put this... Geeks. Three more unlikely heroes there never were.

John Fitzgerald Byers

We defend the defenseless. I don't see any other way.

Morris Fletcher

It wasn't long before their naiveté nearly got them killed. So they hooked up with an FBI agent...

John Fitzgerald Byers

That's why we like you, Mulder. Your ideas are weirder than ours.

Morris Fletcher

...and began publishing a-- what shall I call it-- rag called the lone gunman.

Richard Langly

The guys at the nsa and the cia they tremble every time we put out one of these babies.

Morris Fletcher

From their cramped basement office they pointed fingers at powerful, evil forces. And some not so evil. In their own unique way, the three gunmen were patriots fighting the good fight.

Richard Langly

We tell the stories others refuse to tell.

Morris Fletcher

Yeah, that's one way to put it. And provided, um... Expertise for their friends at the FBI.

Melvin Frohike

She's hot.

Morris Fletcher

For a brief time it looked like they might actually make a difference in this cold, cruel world. They acquired an intern who believed in their cause.

Jimmy Bond

You guys fight the lost causes. I want to help.

Morris Fletcher

And a powerful beautiful nemesis...

[ automatic gunfire ]

Morris Fletcher

...who became an ally. But the world is not kind to idealists and those who fight the good fight don't always win.

[ sonar pinging ]

Brittany?

Monica Reyes

Morris Fletcher

Morris Fletcher

Okay, yeah, th-those are b.s., but only those! See, I-I was freelancing for this foreign billionaire. I told him the air force lost a flying saucer in the bermuda triangle and that I could recover it for him. I just wanted to cruise the bahamas. I never would've given him the real thing. That would be un-american. Well, he found out about it. Now he wants to kill me. I need protection. Super soldiers.

Morris Fletcher
